4k50 (if you’re in an NTSC region use 24/30/60p)
H.264 codec
Apple Log color space
Shutter 1/100 (180 rule most of the time)
Display LUT on (using my cine LUT here)
ISO (I adjust scene depending) and WB is usually auto as I’ll fix in post

Comment “Film” if you want my iPhone LUTs
